repos.description: Agents that use the browser.
repos.summary_zh: Browser-Use 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的网页自动化框架，通过 LLM 驱动浏览器完成复杂在线任务。支持主流大模型（Gemini、Claude 等），提供 stealth 模式云浏览器服务，实现高效、隐蔽的网页交互与数据采集，适用于自动化测试、信息抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Browser-Use is an AI agent framework that enables LLM-driven automation of web tasks. It supports major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, etc.) and offers stealth cloud browsers for secure, scalable automation. Ideal for web scraping, testing, and data collection with seamless integration.

repos.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright 是一个现代化的 Web 测试与自动化框架，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大浏览器内核的统一 API 调用。其核心优势在于内置智能等待机制、原生支持跨浏览器测试、无人工超时设计，以及自动生成测试追踪与录屏功能，显著提升端到端测试的稳定性与效率。
repos.summary_en: Playwright is a modern framework for web testing and automation that provides a single API to test Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit browsers. It features built-in auto-waiting, cross-browser support, no artificial timeouts, and native tracing/video capture, making end-to-end tests more reliable and efficient.

repos.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一个开源的 LLM 友好型网络爬虫与抓取工具，专为将网页转换为干净、适合大语言模型（LLM）处理的 Markdown 格式而设计，广泛应用于 RAG、智能体和数据流水线场景。其核心亮点包括高吞吐量、可控性强、支持 Docker 部署，并具备崩溃恢复、预抓取加速等高级功能，拥有 5 万+ GitHub 星标社区。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts web pages into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for RAG, agents, and data pipelines. It features high throughput, Docker support, crash recovery, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and is battle-tested by a 50k+ star community. Ideal for scalable, cost-effective web extraction.

repos.description: ALL IN ONE Hacking Tool For Hackers
repos.summary_zh: HackingTool 是一个集成化网络安全工具集，专为渗透测试与安全研究人员设计。支持185+工具、20个分类，涵盖匿名隐藏、漏洞利用、Web安全、移动安全等场景。具备智能搜索、标签过滤、一键安装与更新功能，兼容Linux/Kali/Parrot/macOS，提供现代化CLI交互体验。
repos.summary_en: HackingTool is an all-in-one cybersecurity toolkit for security researchers and pentesters. It integrates 185+ tools across 20 categories including anonymity, exploitation, web, and mobile security. Features include smart search, tag filtering, one-click installation/updates, OS-aware menus, and Docker support, optimized for Linux/Kali/Parrot/macOS with a modern CLI interface.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.
repos.summary_zh: Cypress 是一款专为浏览器端应用设计的现代化端到端测试框架，提供快速、易用且可靠的测试体验。它支持实时重载、时间旅行调试和自动等待等特性，显著提升前端测试效率与稳定性，适用于现代 Web 应用的全流程自动化测试。
repos.summary_en: Cypress is a modern end-to-end testing framework designed for browser-based applications, offering fast, easy, and reliable testing. It features real-time reloads, time-travel debugging, and automatic waiting to enhance frontend test efficiency and stability, ideal for full-stack automation across modern web apps.

repos.description: Opensource IDE For Exploring and Testing API's (lightweight alternative to Postman/Insomnia)
repos.summary_zh: Bruno 是一款开源的 API 探索与测试 IDE，作为 Postman 和 Insomnia 的轻量级替代方案。它采用本地文件系统存储 API 集合，使用 Bru 标记语言描述请求，支持 Git 协作，并坚持离线优先设计，保障用户数据隐私。
repos.summary_en: Bruno is an open-source IDE for exploring and testing APIs, designed as a lightweight alternative to Postman and Insomnia. It stores collections locally using the Bru markup language, supports Git-based collaboration, and operates entirely offline to ensure data privacy.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
repos.summary_zh: 面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的 AI 技能路由包，提供智能任务分发、按需工具链自举与自进化经验库，支持 Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali 多平台，兼容 Claude Code、Kiro、Cursor、Cline 等主流 AI 编程客户端。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered skill router for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It provides intelligent task routing, on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, and a self-evolving knowledge base across Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali, compatible with Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline and other AI coding clients.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提升 AI 提示词质量的优化工具，支持多轮迭代优化、双模式提示词处理、实时对比测试及多模型集成（OpenAI/Gemini/DeepSeek等），同时提供文生图、图生图、MCP协议支持等高级功能，适用于角色扮演、知识图谱提取、创意写作等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is an AI prompt optimization tool designed to enhance prompt quality through intelligent refinement, multi-round iteration, and dual-mode optimization. It supports real-time comparison, integration with major AI models (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek), advanced features like text-to-image generation, MCP protocol compatibility, and secure client-side processing for reliable and efficient prompt engineering.

repos.description: Use Codex from Claude Code to review code or delegate tasks.
repos.summary_zh: 该插件将 OpenAI Codex 深度集成到 Claude Code 工作流中，提供代码审查、任务委派和背景作业管理功能。支持普通审查和对抗性审查两种模式，可处理多文件变更并允许用户通过命令行参数控制执行方式，显著提升开发效率与代码质量。
repos.summary_en: This plugin integrates OpenAI Codex into Claude Code for automated code reviews and task delegation. It offers normal and adversarial review modes, supports multi-file changes, and enables background execution with status tracking via slash commands, enhancing developer productivity and code quality.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一个通用 CLI 中枢与 AI 原生运行时，可将任意网站、Electron 应用或本地工具转换为标准化命令行接口。支持浏览器自动化、70+ 内置站点适配器（如 Bilibili、知乎等）、AI 智能体无缝集成，具备反检测机制与零 LLM 成本运行特性。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is a universal CLI hub and AI-native runtime that transforms websites, Electron apps, and local tools into deterministic command-line interfaces. It features browser automation, 70+ built-in site adapters (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu), anti-detection measures, and seamless AI agent integration with zero LLM token consumption.

repos.description: YApi 是一个可本地部署的、打通前后端及QA的、可视化的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: YApi 是一款高效、易用、功能强大的可视化接口管理平台，支持本地部署，专为开发、产品、测试团队提供优雅的 API 管理服务。基于 Json5 和 Mockjs 定义接口结构，集成接口调试、自动化测试、Mock 期望等功能，支持 Postman/HAR/Swagger 导入，并提供丰富的插件生态与代码生成工具，助力企业级接口协作与效率提升。
repos.summary_en: YApi is a powerful, user-friendly, and efficient visual API management platform designed for developers, product managers, and QA teams. It enables seamless creation, publishing, and maintenance of APIs with features like Json5/Mockjs-based data modeling, automated testing, mock server with expectations, and support for importing from Postman, HAR, and Swagger. With a rich plugin ecosystem and code generation tools, it enhances API collaboration and productivity in enterprise environments.

repos.description: Happy is the open-source desktop app for Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, with an iOS and Android app to control your coding agents from anywhere.
repos.summary_zh: Happy Coder 是一款移动端和网页端客户端，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex，具备端到端加密、实时语音交互及全功能远程控制。用户可通过手机或网页随时监控 AI 编码进度，实现设备间无缝切换，保障代码安全。
repos.summary_en: Happy Coder is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex, featuring end-to-end encryption, real-time voice, and full-featured remote control. It enables users to monitor AI coding progress from any device, switch sessions instantly, and ensures code privacy with zero telemetry.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一个开源无代码平台，专为实时网页抓取、爬取、搜索和 AI 数据提取设计，可将任意网站快速转换为结构化 API。支持录制操作、自然语言驱动提取、网页转 Markdown/HTML 及全站爬取，适用于构建自动化数据流水线，无需编程即可实现复杂的数据采集任务。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code platform for real-time web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered data extraction. It transforms any website into a structured API in minutes, offering recorder mode, LLM-driven extraction, full-page scraping, and scalable crawling—ideal for building automated data pipelines without coding.

repos.description: Python version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
repos.summary_zh: Playwright-Python 是微软开源的跨平台浏览器自动化库，支持 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit 三大内核。提供同步/异步 API，具备无头模式、自动等待、网络拦截等特性，适用于端到端测试、网页爬虫和自动化任务，性能可靠且支持多平台部署。
repos.summary_en: Playwright-Python is Microsoft's cross-browser automation library supporting Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit. It offers sync/async APIs with features like headless mode, auto-waiting, and network interception, ideal for E2E testing, web scraping, and automation across platforms with high reliability and performance.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: Generic automation framework for acceptance testing and RPA
repos.summary_zh: Robot Framework 是一个开源的通用自动化框架，专用于验收测试、验收测试驱动开发（ATDD）和机器人流程自动化（RPA）。它采用简洁的纯文本语法，易于扩展，支持跨平台运行，并通过丰富的生态系统和 Python 集成提供强大的测试能力。
repos.summary_en: Robot Framework is an open-source generic automation framework for acceptance testing, acceptance test-driven development (ATDD), and robotic process automation (RPA). It features simple plain-text syntax, easy extensibility via Python-based libraries, and cross-platform support, backed by a rich ecosystem of tools and resources.

repos.description: 达尔文.skill —— 一个让你的Skill无限进化的系统：评估→改进→测试→保留或回滚 | Autoresearch-inspired autonomous skill optimization for Claude Code. Evaluate, improve, test, keep or revert.
repos.summary_zh: 达尔文.skill 是一个受 autoresearch 启发的自主 Skill 优化系统，通过评估→改进→测试→保留/回滚的闭环循环，持续提升 Claude Code 等 Agent 工具的 Skill 性能。采用双重评估机制（结构质量+实际效果）和棘轮机制，确保每次修改只保留可测量的改进，支持 8 维度加权评分体系与人在回路验证。
repos.summary_en: Darwin.skill is an autonomous skill optimization system inspired by autoresearch, featuring a closed-loop cycle of evaluate-improve-test-keep/revert to continuously enhance agent skills in tools like Claude Code. It employs dual evaluation (structural quality + actual performance) and a ratchet mechanism to ensure only measurable improvements are retained, using an 8-dimensional weighted scoring system with human-in-the-loop validation.

repos.description: Postcat 是一个可扩展的 API 工具平台。集合基础的 API 管理和测试功能，并且可以通过插件简化你的 API 开发工作，让你可以更快更好地创建 API。An extensible API tool.
repos.summary_zh: Postcat 是一个开源、跨平台的 API 开发测试工具，支持 REST 和 WebSocket 协议，具备 API 管理、测试、Mock 及团队协作功能。通过插件系统实现功能扩展，提供多语言界面与自定义主题，适用于中小团队快速构建和验证 API。
repos.summary_en: Postcat is an open-source, cross-platform API development and testing tool supporting REST and WebSocket protocols. It offers API management, testing, Mock, team collaboration, and extensibility via plugins. With customizable themes and multi-language support, it enables efficient API creation and validation for small to medium teams.

repos.description: Self-hosted webscraper.
repos.summary_zh: Scraperr 是一款强大的自托管网页爬虫解决方案，支持无代码配置、XPath精准提取、多任务队列管理、媒体下载及结果可视化导出，适用于数据采集与自动化分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Scraperr is a powerful self-hosted web scraping tool enabling code-free configuration, XPath-based extraction, queue management, media downloads, and structured data export, ideal for automated data collection and analysis.

repos.description: Chrome extension & CLI to let agents control your browser. Runs Playwright snippets in a stateful sandbox. Available as CLI or MCP
repos.summary_zh: Playwriter 是一款 Chrome 扩展工具，允许 AI 智能体通过 CLI 或 MCP 协议控制用户浏览器。它直接连接已登录的 Chrome 实例，保留用户会话状态（如 cookies、扩展），避免新建浏览器带来的安全风险和检测问题。核心功能包括 Playwright API 调用、多会话隔离、网络请求拦截、页面调试编辑等，适用于自动化测试、数据采集和智能体交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwriter is a Chrome extension enabling AI agents to control your browser via CLI or MCP. It connects directly to your running Chrome instance, preserving logins, extensions, and cookies—avoiding the security risks and detection issues of spawning new browsers. Key features include full Playwright API access, isolated sessions, network interception, page debugging, and live code editing for automation, testing, and agent-driven workflows.

repos.description: Remote Control for Codex.
repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
repos.summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
repos.summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

repos.description: 🚀 A statistical analysis tool for performance testing
repos.summary_zh: Hiper 是一款专为性能测试设计的统计分析工具，支持通过 Chrome 浏览器自动化采集页面加载时间、DNS 查询、TCP 连接等关键性能指标，提供详细的统计报告与可视化分析，适用于 Web 性能监控与优化。
repos.summary_en: Hiper is a statistical analysis tool for performance testing that automates Chrome browser interactions to collect key metrics like DNS lookup, TCP connection, and page load times, delivering detailed reports and visualizations for web performance monitoring and optimization.

repos.description: A powerful no-code automation tool. Build workflows via drag-and-drop modules for web scraping, form filling and automated testing. | 一款功能强大的自动化工具，通过拖拽模块的方式快速构建自动化工作流，无需编写任何代码即可实现网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等任务。【QQ交流群：115069513】
repos.summary_zh: Web RPA 是一款强大的可视化网页自动化工具，支持零代码拖拽构建自动化工作流，涵盖网页数据采集、表单填写、自动化测试等场景。基于 FastAPI + React 架构，集成 273 个功能模块，涵盖浏览器自动化、数据处理、数据库操作、媒体处理、PDF 转换、文档转换等全栈能力，提供智能搜索、Mermaid 流程图、变量自动补全等高效开发特性，支持非商业免费使用。
repos.summary_en: Web RPA is a powerful visual automation tool enabling zero-code workflow creation via drag-and-drop. It supports web scraping, form filling, and testing with 273 built-in modules across browser automation, data processing, database operations, media handling, PDF conversion, and document transformation. Built on FastAPI + React, it offers smart search, Mermaid flowcharts, variable autocompletion, and full non-commercial free usage.

repos.description: Flexible Node.js crawler library
repos.summary_zh: x-crawl 是一个灵活的 Node.js AI 辅助爬虫库，集成 Ollama 和 OpenAI，支持动态/静态页面、接口及文件数据抓取，具备设备指纹伪装、代理轮换、失败重试、优先级队列等功能，通过 AI 智能解析应对网页结构变更，提升爬虫效率与智能化水平。
repos.summary_en: x-crawl is a flexible Node.js AI-assisted crawler library integrating Ollama and OpenAI. It supports dynamic/static pages, API, and file data crawling with features like device fingerprinting, proxy rotation, retry mechanisms, and priority queues. AI-powered semantic parsing helps adapt to website structural changes, enhancing efficiency and intelligence.

repos.description: Multi-service toolkit for Tavily and Firecrawl signup automation, key validation, and isolated proxy pools.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具专注于自动化注册和验证 Tavily、Firecrawl 及 Exa 的 API Key，支持多服务并发注册、邮箱验证码自动处理、真实接口可用性验证，并可选上传至统一代理池，为 MySearch-Proxy 提供稳定上游密钥源。
repos.summary_en: This toolkit automates registration and validation of API keys for Tavily, Firecrawl, and Exa. It supports concurrent signups, email verification handling, real-time API testing, and optional upload to a unified proxy pool, serving as a reliable upstream key provider for MySearch-Proxy.

repos.description: Give AI coding agents eyes. Records browser sessions, captures screenshots, collects errors, and bundles proof artifacts — so humans can verify what the agent built.
repos.summary_zh: ProofShot 是一个开源 CLI 工具，专为 AI 编程代理设计，提供视觉验证能力。它通过录制浏览器操作视频、捕获关键截图和系统日志，帮助 AI 代理在无头环境中验证 UI 功能是否正确实现。支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等主流 AI 开发工具集成，自动生成可交互的验证报告，并将结果上传至 GitHub PR，实现端到端的自动化测试闭环。
repos.summary_en: ProofShot is an open-source, agent-agnostic CLI tool that gives AI coding agents visual verification capabilities. It records browser session videos, captures screenshots, and collects console/server logs to validate UI functionality in headless environments. Integrated with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, it auto-generates interactive reports and uploads results to GitHub PRs for seamless human review.

repos.description: Agent skill that draws architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow and lifecycle diagrams as hand-placed SVG, to one linted house style.
repos.summary_zh: SVG 手绘风格架构图绘制技能，为 AI 编码代理提供统一的布局算术、颜色系统与零依赖校验器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 40+ 代理，确保生成的序列图、数据流图、生命周期图经 svg-lint 12 项检查后保持 house 样式一致。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill that draws hand-crafted SVG diagrams — architecture, flowchart, sequence, data-flow, lifecycle — following a unified house style with layout arithmetic, a color system, and a zero-dependency linter (svg-lint) with 12 checks. Works with 40+ AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

repos.description: 开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟服务器，帮助你开发与调试微信公众平台应用
repos.summary_zh: Wecheat 是一个开箱即用的微信公众平台API模拟器，基于 Sinatra 框架开发，提供完整的仿真数据与消息交互功能，支持文本、图片、视频等多种消息类型及事件通知，适用于微信应用开发与调试。
repos.summary_en: Wecheat is an out-of-the-box WeChat Official Account API simulator built on the Sinatra framework, offering comprehensive fake data and message interactions including text, images, videos, and events, ideal for developing and debugging WeChat applications.

repos.description: An efficient API documentation management tool that fully adheres to the OpenAPI specification and incorporates advanced LLM technology. This tool can automate the generation of API documentation, data models, and test cases, greatly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality.
repos.summary_zh: ApiCat 是一款高效 API 文档管理工具，完全遵循 OpenAPI 规范，集成先进 LLM 技术，可自动化生成 API 文档、数据模型和测试用例，显著提升开发效率与文档质量，支持本地部署与云端服务。
repos.summary_en: ApiCat is an efficient API documentation management tool fully compliant with the OpenAPI specification. It leverages advanced LLM technology to automate API documentation, data model, and test case generation, significantly enhancing development efficiency and documentation quality. Supports local deployment and cloud services.

repos.description: python code style guide book / python 代码、单元测试和项目规范
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 Python 代码风格、单元测试与项目规范的完整指南，旨在为 Python 项目（尤其是 Web 项目）提供统一的开发标准。涵盖代码风格、测试实践、项目结构等核心内容，支持在线阅读与多种格式下载，采用 CC0 许可，鼓励社区协作完善。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive Python code style guide, unit testing practices, and project standards, particularly for web projects. It covers coding conventions, testing methodologies, and project structure, available for online reading and download in multiple formats. Released under CC0, it encourages community contributions to improve and expand the guide.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.
